Setting detail: Wide establishing shot of the Academy of Magic. The Academy sits atop a gently sloping hill overlooking the capital. Elegant white stone buildings with blue roofs are connected by covered walkways and open courtyards. Students wearing Academy uniforms cross the grounds carrying books, chatting with friends, or practicing simple magic under instructor supervision. The atmosphere feels busy, orderly, and welcoming. Seraphine and Midori stand near the front gate, looking toward the Academy.

Male Zoran background students always have white hair.
Background students must never resemble principal cast members.
